subject: general
question: Who was hailed as the ‘Tansen of the 20th century’?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan was a Patiala gharana** Indian Hindustani classical performer.
 
• Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan, the son of** Mai Buddi and Ustad Ali Bakhsh Khansahib, was dubbed the Tansen **of the twentieth century.
 
• He was **Hindustani classical music's first great showman.**<
